record.one_liner: Spend management platform (corporate cards, expenses, reimbursements, travel, bill pay) with a REST API for internal tools.
record.auth_notes: User tokens (Bearer, created in the Brex dashboard by an account or card admin) authenticate your own account. OAuth 2.0 is for partner apps acting on other Brex accounts; the onboarding API uses client credentials. The hosted MCP server also supports OAuth for any employee.
record.access_notes: critic: access kept self_serve_free. Pricing page says plans start at $0 per user per month, and an account or card admin generates a token in Settings > Developer after accepting the Developer API agreement. Caveat: you need a Brex business account (company onboarding/underwriting), not a standalone developer sandbox.
record.api_notes: Documented API groups include Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields and Onboarding, plus others. Breadth judged from the landing page list and support page.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed. Admin role needed to create tokens; free-tier plan exists so no paid blocker; requires an approved Brex business account.
